decisions.reason: The cobot loading system was launched only in 2024 and fits the firm's push toward smarter automation, so its prospects are still uncertain, keeping it as an accessory option costs little, and there is no evidence yet that justifies abandoning it.
The dual-table loading system is a low-cost automation add-on that complements the core machining systems, and with only one year of results the option should stay open until demand becomes clearer.
The dispensing machine is a flagship with its own web page and a Red Dot award, which are early positive signals that favor further commitment rather than abandonment.
